nodes.label: Registrar Managed-Product DNS Binding Trap
nodes.summary: Consumer registrars (GoDaddy, Squarespace, Wix, Namecheap) auto-attach new domains to their hosted-website product, surfacing a fake DNS row the merchant can't delete via the DNS panel. The fix is product-level disconnect (My Products → Websites + Marketing → Remove domain), not DNS editing.

nodes.label: Multi-A-Record Round-Robin (67% Parking Page)
nodes.summary: Merchants ADD the new A record without deleting stale ones, creating 2-3 A records on the apex. DNS resolvers round-robin across all, so 2/3 of visitors land on the parking page. Detection: `dig @<authoritative-ns> +short A example.com` returning 3+ lines. Fix: delete all A records except the platform-target one.

nodes.label: DNS Records Table Contract (5-Column + Copy)
nodes.summary: Admin DNS records tables MUST include Type/Name/Value/Priority/TTL columns plus a copy button per row and break-all on the value cell. A 3-column table forces merchants to ask for Priority (MX=10) and TTL defaults, creating per-onboarding friction. DKIM TXT values are ~400 chars — truncation without break-all breaks copy-paste at registrars.

nodes.label: Provision→Verify Status Machine: Button on Every Non-Terminal State
nodes.summary: Gating the 'Verify' button on a single intermediate state (e.g. `pending` only) leaves merchants stuck when the provider returns `not_started` or `failed` instead. Rule: show the next-action button on EVERY non-terminal state; hide ONLY on the terminal happy state (`verified`). Applies to Resend domains, AWS SES, Stripe webhooks, TLS cert provisioning, identity verification.

nodes.label: Provider Status Enum Reference (Resend / SES / Stripe / OneSignal)
nodes.summary: Canonical status enums for provisioned-resource state machines: Resend domains (not_started/pending/verified/failed), Vercel domains (verified bool + misconfigured bool), AWS SES (NotStarted/Pending/Success/Failed/TemporaryFailure), Stripe webhooks (enabled/disabled), OneSignal (subscribed/unsubscribed/not_supported). Resend and SES explicitly have a `not_started` state distinct from `pending` — the universal trap source.
